verdict_reason: Set-up migration keeps every expected status and adds the Latin name where the permanent-address rule needs it, but species constants and cattle-line fixtures are copied across test files and several titles narrate history or over-claim.

todos.issue: The PR declares species constants locally (EQUUS_CABALUS and BOS_TAURUS at lines 25-26 here, BOS_TAURUS at status.test.js:23) and the same 'Bos taurus' / 'Felis catus' / 'Equus cabalus' constants are redeclared in about 20 test files (contract.test.js:48-49, store-ops.test.js:19-21, collection-complete.test.js:7, fulfilments.test.js:8, mutators.test.js:18-19, notification-mapper.test.js:14-15, identification.fit.spec.js:19-21, ...); the complete cattle line {commodityCode '0102', speciesLatinName BOS_TAURUS, commodityType '16', numberOfPackages, numberOfAnimalsQuantity} is copied across task-rows.test.js (160-245, 423-429) and status.test.js (133-140, 297-304, 378-383); 'Felis catus' is still a raw literal at line 291 and status.test.js:336
todos.fix: Must: one shared test helper owns the species names and the canonical commodity-line fixtures the flow tests use, and the local copies are deleted. One way: export CATTLE/HORSE/CAT line builders and the Latin-name constants from a shared live-animals test-support module (next to the commodities stub fixtures) and import them in task-rows.test.js, status.test.js and the other files

todos.issue: Test titles narrate history: describe at line 414 'admits exactly the journeys the section roll-up did', it.each at line 509 'agree with the retired section roll-up', and line 539 'gated on the row roll-up exactly as before'
todos.fix: Must: titles state the current behaviour with no before/after narration. One way: 'the row roll-up and the section roll-up admit the same journeys', 'Should agree with the section roll-up for %s', 'Should gate the review section on the row roll-up'

todos.issue: Title 'Should be marked conditional so the hub drops it while it is Not applicable' claims hub behaviour, but the only assertion is taskRowById('animalIdentification').conditional === true
todos.fix: Must: the title claims no more than the assertion proves, or the test asserts the hub drop. One way: retitle to 'Should mark the animal-identification row conditional', and prove the hub drop in the hub view-model test
